names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος ο Ιερομάρτυρας πάπας Ρώμης», with the rank words left off. The page adds that the Synaxarist of Nikodemos and the Menaia call him «Αλεξανδρίων», a form it rejects as the name of no pope of Rome.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 16 марта ст. ст., «Святитель Александр I Римский, папа, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The regnal numeral is part of the name the link gives; «папа» is the office and is left to the folder's own office field. The day's own line declines the name to «Александра» and puts the see in a phrase, «папы Римского».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Александра, папы Римского (119).»

attestations.note: The julian 16/3 is the same menologion day the Greek keeps him on. The line closes with a year, 119, where saint.gr gave only the reign of Hadrian, and the life page behind the line gives the day as well: «Он был заживо сожжен 3 мая 119 года по повелению императора Адриана (117 - 138)». The death is therefore recorded as 119, a year inside the reign the folder already held, and the note on the interval names both readings. The 3 мая of that sentence is the day of the burning as this page gives it and not a feast; no calendar read keeps him on it. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος ο Ιερομάρτυρας πάπας Ρώμης»

attestations.note: The page corrects the name it inherits: «Από τον Συναξαριστή του Αγίου Νικόδημου και τα Μηναία, καλείται Αλεξανδρίων. Αλλά με τέτοιο όνομα πάπας Ρώμης δεν υπήρξε ποτέ. Πρόκειται λοιπόν για τον πάπα Αλέξανδρο τον Α' (105 - 115 μ.Χ.)» — the Synaxarist of Nikodemos and the Menaia call him Alexandrion, but no pope of Rome ever bore such a name, so this is pope Alexander I. It then says he was elected bishop of Rome in 105, that Eusebius, reworking a notice of Irenaeus of Lyon, makes him fifth in order of the bishops of Rome, and that he was martyred under the emperor Hadrian (117–138) — which does not agree with the 105–115 of its own bracket, and both readings are recorded and neither resolved. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: Two calendars, and the Russian one is the more exact without contradicting the other. saint.gr gave only the reign: «Μαρτύρησε επί αυτοκράτορα Αδριανού (117 - 138)». days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 16 марта ст. ст. with «(119)» and its life page says «Священномученик Александр, папа Римский, занимал папский престол в течение 10 лет. Он был заживо сожжен 3 мая 119 года по повелению императора Адриана (117 - 138)». 119 falls inside the reign saint.gr names, so the year is taken and the reign is not contradicted.
